title: Joint monicity of stable pullback image projections
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone such that its object and arrow set cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Fix $j\in J$, $f:Y\to X$ and $g:Z\to X$ in $F(j)$ admitting a pullback $P=Y\times_X Z$, with projections $p:P\to Y$ and $q:P\to Z$. Assume every transition out of $j$ preserves this pullback. Write $U_j$ for the cocone functor $F(j)\to V.\mathrm{pt}$. For every object $W$ of $V.\mathrm{pt}$ and arrows $a,b:W\to U_j(P)$, if $U_j(p)\circ a=U_j(p)\circ b$ and $U_j(q)\circ a=U_j(q)\circ b$, then $a=b$. No existence of a factorization for arbitrary cones is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09YL (lemma-colimit-sites), pullback paragraph and displayed Hom calculation; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YL

proof.text:
Lift the two proposed arrows to stage arrows using joint surjectivity
of the arrow colimit. Move their stages and j to a common upper stage. Eventual
equality in the object colimit aligns their sources with each other and their
targets with the transitioned pullback object. After these identifications,
their composites with the transitioned projections have equal colimit images.
Use eventual equality in the arrow colimit twice to enforce these two equalities
at a later stage. The pullback remains preserved by the composite transition
out of j, so its two projections are jointly monic there. The two stage arrows
are equal, and applying the cocone functor proves equality of the original
arrows. This uses no existence of a factorization for an arbitrary cone.

theorem filteredColimit_pullback_hom_ext
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (j : J) {X Y Z : F.obj j} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X) [HasPullback f g]
    (hpres : ∀ (k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor) :
    ∀ (W : V.pt) (a b : W ⟶ (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj (pullback f g)),
      a ≫ (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.map (pullback.fst f g) =
        b ≫ (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.map (pullback.fst f g) →
      a ≫ (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.map (pullback.snd f g) =
        b ≫ (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.map (pullback.snd f g) → a = b
